decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted 13th July 2016 and numbered Supporting Statement, and WWY26-01 and 02, submitted 14th November 2016 and numbered WWY26-03 Rev. A, and 04 Rev. A, and submitted 16th November 2016 and numbered WWY26-05 Rev. B, therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the side walls of the extension hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.
description: Erection of a two storey side, single storey rear and a front porch extensions following demolition of a garage and a rear roof extension incorporating hip to gable conversion, Juliet balcony and two front roof windows to the house
